annotations.title: Compare Korea ticket vs presale tax

description: Korean capital gains tax on a redevelopment/reconstruction member right (조합원입주권) vs an apartment pre-sale right (분양권) (소득세법 제104조①): member rights are taxed like houses (under 1 year 70%, under 2 years 60%, then 6-45%), original members get the long-term holding deduction on the gain up to the management-disposal approval date and the one-house exemption up to 1.2B if the old house qualified on that date; pre-sale rights are 70% under 1 year then 60%, with no deduction or exemption. 2.5M basic deduction, +10% local tax. Returns the chosen right's tax plus both totals.

holdYears.description: Holding period in years (original members count from the old house's acquisition)

liveYears.description: Years lived in the old house (one-house deduction table 2)

oneHouseExempt.description: Met the one-house exemption on the approval date with no other house

original.description: Original member who owned the old house

preApprovalGain.description: Gain up to the management-disposal approval date (original members) (KRW)

yearsToApproval.description: Years from old house acquisition to the approval date
